A garage in Larnaca

J.M.E. Garage works at Fedras & Psiloritis, Akinita Savvides 6, in Larnaca. Its sign names services, car repairs, bodywork, diagnostics and a courtesy car when available. It opens at 7:30 from Monday to Saturday, and 13 of its 15 Google reviews give five stars.
